create.name: Rob Bell
create.bio:
Rob Bell is an author, speaker and spiritual teacher who spent some twenty years as a pastor before turning to writing and teaching full time. His books and plays, fourteen in all, have been translated into twenty-five languages and include Velvet Elvis and Love Wins, which reread the Christian story with an emphasis on God's love for everyone, What Is the Bible?, which approaches scripture as human writing that still carries surprising depth, and Everything Is Spiritual, which links the story of an expanding universe with the questions of an ordinary life.

Much of his recent teaching is about creativity, presence and finding the next step, as in his book How to Be Here. From his home in Ojai, California, he runs small two-day gatherings where each person brings a question about what they are making or saying and the group works through it together, and he leads occasional weekend retreats and week-long workshops elsewhere. He also hosts The RobCast, a long-running podcast of talks and conversations, releases longer audio teachings on communication, money, fear and failure, and makes visual art and music with his band Humans on the Floor.

books.title: Love Wins
books.author: Rob Bell
books.description: He argues that the heart of Jesus' story is God's love for every person, and questions the narrower versions of the Christian message many readers grew up with.

books.title: Velvet Elvis: Repainting the Christian Faith
books.author: Rob Bell
books.description: Presents Christian faith as a living tradition that keeps being explored and reworked, and invites readers to rethink belief, the Bible and hope.

books.title: What We Talk About When We Talk About God
books.author: Rob Bell
books.description: Written from his years as a pastor, it looks at why the word God has become so loaded and offers a fresher way of thinking about the divine in everyday life.

books.title: What Is the Bible?
books.author: Rob Bell
books.description: A New York Times bestseller that reads the Bible as a human library written over centuries. He shows how its stories carry ideas still ahead of their time.

books.title: How to Be Here
books.author: Rob Bell
books.description: A practical book about being fully present and making a meaningful life out of the work and days you already have.

books.title: Everything Is Spiritual
books.author: Rob Bell
books.description: Traces where his ideas about an expanding universe came from in his own life story, and invites readers to grow and expand along with it.

courses.title: And Then We Kept Going: A Retreat with Rob Bell
courses.description: A weekend retreat at the Art of Living Retreat Center in Boone, North Carolina. Through conversation, journaling, simple drawing and questions, participants look again at old ideas of productivity, fear and failure.

courses.title: MEA Workshop in Mexico
courses.description: A week of teaching with Rob Bell at the Modern Elder Academy's seaside campus in Baja, Mexico, built around the question of what to do with the rest of your life.

courses.title: Find Me a Straight River: A 3 Hour Audiobook on Fear and Failure
courses.description: A three-hour audio teaching that uses the winding of rivers and the patience of nature to look again at fear, failure and the sense of being behind in life.

free_resources.title: The RobCast
free_resources.description: His free podcast of talks and conversations, with more than four hundred episodes. New episodes reach Patreon supporters first and then the main podcast apps.
